submission.reasoning: On workstation5, cmd.exe wrote C:\Users\wardog\AppData\Local\Temp\art.bat at 02:46:45 on 2020-10-20, then launched reg.exe as WORKSTATION5\wardog at high integrity at 02:47:08. reg.exe set HKCU\Environment\UserInitMprLogonScript to that batch file; the registry-write event and resulting value confirm logon-script persistence. A newly created temporary-directory script registered for execution at logon, without evidence of authorized management activity, supports a malicious persistence verdict. Isolate the workstation, rotate the involved account credentials, remove the persistence value, and delete the batch payload. Payload contents and subsequent logon execution were not established.
